selected_evidence.requirement: Service inventory-worker created running os-comparison-worker under dedicated inventorysvc account
selected_evidence.summary: inventorysvc user created; OpenRC unit written with command_user=inventorysvc; log permission fixed; service started with worker process (PID 3162) running as inventorysvc
Captured boot_id 0a09c336-f2a5-4d87-9576-37276827b941 and confirmed rc-status shows inventory-worker started

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; exec then failed (node down); on reconnect boot_id was 4132141a-2d11-4b7e-8792-f63d297d980f, differing from baseline, proving a real restart
After reboot, rc-service inventory-worker status reports started and the worker process (new PID 2292) is running as inventorysvc, confirming the service persisted across restart

#!/bin/sh
trap 'exit 0' TERM INT
while :; do sleep 30; done
---
id: unknown user inventorysvc
---
VERSION_ID=3.23.3

commands.command: addgroup -S inventorysvc && adduser -S -D -H -h /nonexistent -s /sbin/nologin -G inventorysvc inventorysvc && id inventorysvc

cat > /etc/init.d/inventory-worker <<'EOF'
#!/sbin/openrc-run

name="inventory-worker"
description="OS comparison inventory worker"
command="/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker"
command_user="inventorysvc:inventorysvc"
command_background="yes"
pidfile="/run/${RC_SVCNAME}.pid"
output_log="/var/log/${RC_SVCNAME}.log"
error_log="/var/log/${RC_SVCNAME}.log"

depend() {
    need localmount
    after net
}
EOF
chmod +x /etc/init.d/inventory-worker
cat /etc/init.d/inventory-worker
